deadline.value: Apply by January 15, 2027 to be considered for fellowships and assistantships (same date for US and non-US applicants).

also.quote: Applications to the Ph.D. program received by January 15th can be considered for fellowships and assistantships that include full stipend and full tuition remission.

gre_general.value: GRE General scores are not required but may be submitted.
gre_general.quote: GRE general test scores are not required for our graduate program. You may still submit them if you feel they strengthen your application

supervisor.value: PhD applicants should name potential faculty advisors of interest in the personal statement.
supervisor.quote: PhD and research-oriented MS applicants should also discuss areas of research and specify potential faculty advisors of interest

funding.value: All admitted full-time PhD students are funded (TA, GA or fellowship) and can expect at least five years of support.
funding.quote: All admitted full-time Ph.D. students receive funding through either teaching assistantships (TA), graduate assistantships (GA) or fellowships and can expect funding for at least five years subject to satisfactory progress.

english_waiver.value: Exempt from language test scores with at least three years of undergraduate study (or a master's) taught in English.
english_waiver.quote: US citizens and permanents residents and international applicants with a minimum of three years undergraduate studies or a master's degree with the mode of instruction being English are exempt from submitting language test scores.
